statistic.name: cfa_fit
statistic.notes: A second-order model fit poorly (RMSEA = .09, TLI = .72). A first-order model with one Sense of Belonging factor indicated by the five subscale means fit well: RMSEA = .056, TLI = .95, chi-square(5) = 12.86 (ratio 2.57). Loadings: Membership .56, Acceptance .94, Affect .78, Desire to Fade .71, Trust .49. Composite alpha = .78.

sample.description: Study 1, confirmatory half: 498 calculus students (241 men, 257 women) at a highly selective university in the Northeast US.

source.citation: Good, C., Rattan, A., & Dweck, C. S. (2012). Why do women opt out? Sense of belonging and women's representation in mathematics. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 102(4), 700-717.
